$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFFW (AIP France, chart dated 2022-08-11): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
Paramotor activity is carried out exclusively from the circular area dedicated to this activity.
Simultaneous use of the RWYs is prohibited (only one movement on all 3 RWYs at a time).

TKOF or LDG is forbidden on RWY 07R-25L in case of: Presence of a person on the circular area; Presence of a glider on the glider RWY found less than a half width of the common limit.; Presence of an ACFT or a vehicle on the parallel TWY.
From NOV 1st to MAR 31st, possible operating restrictions after heavy rainfalls.
